Name: Flower Dance Shop
Author: scrotorrr
Description: Tired of looking like a dorkus porkus when you go to your first Flower Dance?  Welllll, now Suki sells clothes that make you blend in just a touch better! They're vanilla clothes, so they're not a perfect match, but it's better than showing up in your overalls :) You can find them in her traveling cart on the 19th and 21st of spring and have them in time for the festival!

Manifest.Name: Flower Dance Shop
Manifest.Description: Adds clothes to Suki's shop so you blend in a little better at the Flower Dance.
